scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$(basename "${npm_execpath:-}")" in pnpm|pnpm.cjs|pnpm.mjs) exit 0 ;; esac; echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1'
scripts.start: pnpm run build:local && PORT=3000 SERVE_WEB=1 pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run start
scripts.build:local: pnpm --filter @workspace/powamov run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.build:workspace: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm run typecheck:vercel && pnpm run typecheck:netlify && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
